## Validation

List the checks actually run and any limitations. Use "not run" where appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and matches the repository's role.
- [ ] Plans are clearly distinguished from implemented features.
- [ ] Links and image paths have been checked.
- [ ] No private data, credentials or unlicensed third-party materials are included.
